name: Monitoring U
source:
A toxic yuri visual novel about an immortal alien girl and the scientist trying to kill her.

You control Cybin, the scientist that found U-836 in the first place, who wants her dead at all costs.

U-836, or simply 'U' for short, is an alien? Mushroom girl? Thing???? Whatever she is, she wants Cybin. Badly. 

[From [url=https://crashquartz.itch.io/monitoring-u]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部有毒的尤里视觉小说，讲述了一个不朽的外星女孩和试图杀死她的科学家。

你控制的是最初发现U-836的科学家Cybin，他不惜一切代价想要杀死她。

U-836，或者简称“U”，是外星人吗？蘑菇女孩？事物？？？？不管她是什么，她想要Cybin。糟糕的是。

[来自[url=https://crashquartz.itch.io/monitoring-u]itch.io[/url]]
